root = Stack([header, searchBox, kpis, tableCard], 16)
$search = ""

header = Text("Recent Transactions", "heading")
searchBox = Input("Search", $search, "Search by merchant, category, descriptor...", "search")
kpis = Row([countStat, sumStat], 16)
countStat = Stat("Total Results", txns.total, "number")
sumStat = Stat("Total Amount", @Sum(txns.data.amount), "money")
tableCard = Surface([table], "Transaction Details")
table = DataTable(txns.data, cols, "timestamp desc", 20, ["category", "status"], true, 10, "No transactions found.")
cols = [{ key: "merchant", label: "Merchant" }, { key: "category", label: "Category" }, { key: "amount", label: "Amount", format: "money", align: "end" }, { key: "timestamp", label: "Date", format: "datetime" }, { key: "status", label: "Status" }]
